themes.label: US team game winner (moneyline)
themes.businesses: sports bars, restaurants/bars near arenas & campuses, team-merch shops, parking lots, pedicabs/rideshare drivers, promo-running retailers
themes.story: Direct: a home loss (or a game that doesn't happen) cuts post-game crowds and celebration spending; a shop running a 'free X if we win' promo is short the win. Buy the side that pays when revenue is bad (opponent wins) or the side that funds the promo.

themes.label: Season futures: wins, playoffs, titles, awards
themes.businesses: stadium-district bars/restaurants/hotels (extra home playoff dates), merch shops, local TV/radio ad sellers, promo-running brands ('free tacos if the Spurs make the playoffs')
themes.story: Proxy: deep playoff runs add home dates and foot traffic; missing the playoffs removes them. Also funds season-long promos with a known worst case.

themes.label: Game lines & props (totals, spreads, quarters, players)
themes.businesses: bars/restaurants funding score-based promos ('half-price wings if 30+ points')
themes.story: Promo funding only: a totals/score line pays when the promo is triggered. Not a revenue-loss hedge.

themes.label: Other sports (intl soccer, tennis, golf, MMA, esports, cricket, motorsport)
themes.businesses: ex-pat/soccer pubs (EPL, Liga MX, UCL nights), golf-tournament host towns, fight-night bars
themes.story: Mostly irrelevant; a Liga MX or Premier League pub can treat its team's match like a local game.

themes.label: Ski resort opening dates & resort snowfall
themes.businesses: ski/snowboard rental & tune shops, ski-town restaurants, bars, lodging, ski schools, shuttle operators
themes.story: Direct: a late opening or thin early-season snowfall wipes out the Thanksgiving-Christmas peak. Buy 'opens after <date>' or 'snowfall below X'.

themes.label: City snowfall (monthly totals, snow-day counts, white Christmas)
themes.businesses: restaurants & retail (snow-day closures), daycare, delivery/couriers, salons, gyms; plow/snow-removal contractors and hardware stores (hedge the opposite: a snowless winter)
themes.story: Direct: heavy snow closes storefronts and kills foot traffic; plow operators lose contract income in a dry winter. Monthly 'snow above X in' markets settle on NWS station totals.

themes.label: Hurricanes & named storms (counts, landfall by city/state)
themes.businesses: coastal restaurants, hotels & short-term rentals, marinas, charter fishing, beach retail, event venues in FL/TX/LA/Carolinas/Gulf
themes.story: Direct: a landfall near you means evacuation, closures and cancelled bookings. City/state landfall markets ('hurricane hits Tampa/Texas coast') are the closest thing to parametric storm cover.

themes.label: Daily high temperature by city
themes.businesses: patio bars & restaurants, food trucks, outdoor markets/events, ice-cream & shaved-ice stands (hedge cool days), landscapers & roofers (lost heat days), golf courses
themes.story: Direct: extreme heat (or an unseasonably cold day for cold-treat sellers) cuts outdoor traffic. Binary 'high >= X' settles on the NWS station reading for that day.

themes.label: Daily low temperature / freeze by city
themes.businesses: plant nurseries & farms (frost), outdoor dining, food trucks, car washes, event rentals; plumbers/HVAC benefit (hedge mild winters)
themes.story: Direct: a hard freeze kills nursery stock and empties patios. 'Low <= 32F' is a parametric frost cover.

themes.label: Weekly/monthly average temperature, degree days
themes.businesses: HVAC contractors, utilities-cost-heavy shops (bakeries, laundromats, greenhouses), seasonal apparel retailers, propane/heating-oil dealers
themes.story: Direct: a warm winter (few heating degree days) hurts heating-fuel dealers and coat sellers; a hot month raises cooling bills. Settles on a period average, so it hedges a season not a day.

themes.label: Monthly / multi-day rainfall totals by city
themes.businesses: landscapers, painters, roofers & builders (lost workdays), golf courses, outdoor venues, car washes; farms/vineyards (drought side: hedge too little rain)
themes.story: Direct: a wet month means rained-out workdays and empty patios; a dry one hurts growers. 'Rain above X inches in <month>' settles on the NWS/Weather Company station total.

themes.label: Daily / weekend / holiday rain by city
themes.businesses: patio bars, outdoor events & weddings, food trucks, farmers markets, amusement parks, bike/kayak rentals, car washes
themes.story: Direct: rain on your one big day (Saturday market, festival, Thanksgiving) is the classic parametric event cover.

themes.label: Tornado counts, natural-disaster declarations
themes.businesses: Plains/Southeast retailers & farms, mobile-home parks, outdoor venues; roofers & restoration firms benefit
themes.story: Direct (city 'natural disaster hits X' markets) or proxy (national tornado counts) for storm-driven closures.

themes.label: Earthquakes, volcanoes, tsunami
themes.businesses: California/Pacific NW/Hawaii businesses with uninsured interruption risk, Big Island tourism (Kilauea)
themes.story: Direct but low-probability/catastrophic: a cheap YES on 'M8+ in California' is a tail hedge for business interruption.

themes.label: Water levels & drought (Lake Mead/Powell, Mississippi)
themes.businesses: Lake Mead/Powell marinas & boat rentals, Mississippi barge/grain shippers, farms, golf courses facing watering limits
themes.story: Proxy: low water shuts boat ramps and raises barge freight; drought means irrigation cuts.

themes.label: Air quality (AQI)
themes.businesses: outdoor dining, tour operators, youth sports camps, gyms with outdoor classes
themes.story: Direct: smoke days (AQI > 150) cancel outdoor activity. Kalshi has listed city AQI markets (KXAQICITY); none open right now.

themes.label: Climate & ENSO (El Niño, hottest year, sea ice, CO2)
themes.businesses: seasonal planners (El Niño = wetter Gulf/South winter, warmer North)
themes.story: Weak seasonal proxy; mostly not a business hedge.

themes.label: Natural gas price
themes.businesses: restaurants & bakeries (gas ranges/ovens), greenhouses, laundromats & dry cleaners, heating-cost-heavy shops
themes.story: Direct cost proxy for gas utility bills (Henry Hub feeds retail tariffs with a lag).

themes.label: Retail gasoline price (AAA national & state)
themes.businesses: delivery & courier services, rideshare/taxi drivers, food trucks, landscapers, mobile groomers, plumbers/HVAC/electrician fleets, lawn care
themes.story: Direct cost hedge: YES on 'AAA average above $X' pays when fuel costs spike. State markets exist for TX, CA, FL, NY, NJ.

themes.label: Diesel price
themes.businesses: truckers & freight brokers, farms, construction contractors, moving companies, food distributors, fishing boats
themes.story: Direct cost hedge on the fuel that runs commercial vehicles; settles on EIA/AAA diesel averages.

themes.label: Electricity price / grid stress (ERCOT, PJM, MISO, CPI electricity)
themes.businesses: restaurants & bars (refrigeration, kitchens), laundromats, ice makers, cold storage, small manufacturers, crypto/AI micro-datacenters, greenhouses
themes.story: Direct: real-time power price or grid-emergency spikes (Texas summer) drive bills; ERCOT peak demand is also a heat proxy.

themes.label: Crude oil (WTI, Brent) & oil chokepoints
themes.businesses: anything fuel- or plastics-heavy: delivery fleets, airlines-exposed travel agencies, plastics/packaging buyers
themes.story: Proxy: crude leads gasoline/diesel by ~2 weeks; Hormuz/Red Sea markets are tail hedges for an oil shock.

themes.label: Food & grocery prices (eggs, beef, wings, coffee, FAO index, menu prices)
themes.businesses: restaurants, bakeries, cafes, diners, wing bars, food trucks, caterers, grocery/convenience stores
themes.story: Direct input-cost hedge: YES on 'egg/beef/wing price above X' pays when the menu margin gets squeezed.

themes.label: Farm & fishery output (corn yield, milk, cattle, lobster, maple, cotton)
themes.businesses: farms & ranches, co-ops, farm-supply stores, seafood restaurants/markets (lobster, salmon), maple producers, distilleries
themes.story: Direct for producers (low yield/landings), proxy for buyers (scarcity = higher input prices).

themes.label: Metals & materials (gold, silver, copper, aluminum, lumber, paper)
themes.businesses: jewelers (gold/silver), electricians & HVAC (copper), craft brewers/canners (aluminum premium), builders (lumber), print shops (paper index)
themes.story: Direct input-cost hedge: YES on 'gold above X' offsets a jeweler's restocking cost; 'aluminum Midwest premium above X' offsets can costs.

themes.label: Shipping & ports (container volume, freight index)
themes.businesses: importers, e-commerce sellers, furniture/appliance retailers, customs brokers, port-adjacent trucking
themes.story: Proxy: freight-rate spikes raise landed cost; port volume falls signal slower local logistics work.

themes.label: Tariffs & trade deals
themes.businesses: importers & retailers of imported goods (apparel, electronics, furniture), auto-repair (parts), craft brewers (aluminum), restaurants buying imported produce/wine, Canadian/Mexican cross-border shops
themes.story: Direct: YES on 'US tariff rate on China/Canada above X' pays exactly when landed costs jump.

themes.label: Minimum wage & labor rules
themes.businesses: restaurants, retail, childcare, cleaning services, home-care agencies (wage-heavy cost base)
themes.story: Direct: 'state/city raises minimum wage to X' resolves YES when payroll costs rise.

themes.label: Government shutdown & federal funding
themes.businesses: businesses near federal workforces (DC, military bases), national-park gateway towns, government contractors, SBA-loan applicants
themes.story: Direct: a shutdown halts federal paychecks, closes parks, freezes SBA lending. 'Shutdown by <date>' / 'shutdown length > X days' pay exactly then.

themes.label: Cannabis legalization & banking
themes.businesses: dispensaries, hemp/THC-drink shops, grow suppliers, smoke shops
themes.story: Direct: rescheduling/280E relief changes the tax bill; a state legalization creates competition (hedge with YES) or opportunity.

themes.label: Tax policy (tips, gas tax, property & corporate tax, IRS)
themes.businesses: restaurants (tip taxation), landlords (property tax), fuel retailers (gas tax holiday), NYC businesses (Mamdani tax plans)
themes.story: Direct where a tax change hits the P&L; stimulus/tariff-dividend checks are a demand proxy for retail.

themes.label: Local/state rules & ordinances (rent freeze, bans, moratoria, permits)
themes.businesses: landlords & property managers (rent freeze), NYC retailers, businesses in states debating data-center/sports-betting/raw-milk rules
themes.story: Direct: buy YES on the rule that would hurt you (e.g. 'rent freeze enacted').

themes.label: Immigration enforcement & visas
themes.businesses: construction, agriculture, landscaping, restaurants & hotels relying on immigrant labor
themes.story: Proxy for labor-supply shocks.

themes.label: Mortgage rates & Treasury yields
themes.businesses: realtors, mortgage brokers, home builders & remodelers, movers, title companies, furniture & home-improvement stores
themes.story: Direct demand hedge: transactions dry up when the 30-yr rate rises; YES on 'rate above X' pays when deal flow falls.

themes.label: Fed / central-bank rate decisions
themes.businesses: any business with a variable-rate loan, SBA 7(a) loan or line of credit; equipment lessors
themes.story: Direct: SBA 7(a) loans float on Prime (Fed funds + 3%); YES on 'no cut'/'hike' offsets higher interest.

themes.label: Housing (permits, starts, home prices, rents, home sales)
themes.businesses: contractors & trades, realtors, landlords, building-supply yards, interior designers, cleaners/movers
themes.story: Direct: fewer permits/sales = fewer jobs for trades; state-level permit markets (CA, CO, VT, CT) map to local builders.

themes.label: Travel & tourism (TSA throughput, airport passengers, visitors, hotels, cruises, parks)
themes.businesses: hotels/B&Bs, tour operators, souvenir shops, airport shuttles & parking, restaurants in tourist districts (Orlando, Las Vegas, Hawaii, Florida, national-park gateways)
themes.story: Proxy with local resolution: 'Florida/Nevada/Hawaii visitors below X', 'Orlando hotel demand up?', 'Canadian trips to US down 20%' track exactly the crowds a tourist-town shop sells to.

themes.label: Consumer spend & traffic (card spend, foot traffic, POS, retail sales, sentiment)
themes.businesses: restaurants (Chick-fil-A/Olive Garden/Chipotle/LongHorn spend), coffee shops (coffee-chain traffic array), discount & sporting-goods retail (Dollar General, Academy, Dick's), beauty (Sephora), energy-drink/soda distributors
themes.story: Sector proxy: Carbon Arc card-spend / foot-traffic markets on big chains move with the same local demand a small competitor sees. Buy 'below X' to hedge a sector slowdown.

themes.label: Jobs, unemployment, jobless claims, state/industry employment
themes.businesses: discretionary retail & restaurants (demand), staffing agencies, businesses in one-industry towns (aerospace in WA, autos in MI, semis in AZ/OR)
themes.story: Proxy: rising local unemployment cuts discretionary spend; state-industry employment markets track company-town demand.

themes.label: GDP & recession
themes.businesses: discretionary businesses: restaurants, salons, gyms, boutiques, travel agencies, event planners
themes.story: Proxy tail hedge: 'recession in 2027' pays in the scenario where discretionary revenue falls.

themes.label: Inflation (CPI, PCE, Truflation, category CPIs)
themes.businesses: fixed-price sellers (contractors with bids, subscription businesses), restaurants (menu pricing lag)
themes.story: Proxy: high inflation squeezes fixed-price margins. Category CPIs (used cars, electricity, groceries) are tighter.

themes.label: FX & dollar index
themes.businesses: importers/exporters, border-town retailers (Canadian/Mexican shoppers), tourism businesses reliant on foreign visitors
themes.story: Direct: a strong dollar keeps foreign tourists home and cheapens imports.

themes.label: Equity indices (S&P 500, Nasdaq) & largest company
themes.businesses: luxury retail, wealth-sensitive services (boat dealers, high-end restaurants) via the wealth effect
themes.story: Weak proxy for affluent-customer spending.

themes.label: Disease outbreaks (measles, H5N1, pandemics, dengue, screwworm)
themes.businesses: event venues & tour operators (pandemic), poultry farms & egg buyers (H5N1), Florida tourism (dengue), daycare
themes.story: Proxy: outbreaks trigger closures or supply shocks (bird flu -> egg prices).

themes.label: GPU rental & AI token prices
themes.businesses: small AI/SaaS startups, render farms, agencies reselling AI services
themes.story: Direct cost hedge on compute: YES on 'H100 hourly above $X' pays when inference costs rise.

themes.label: Box office, film slate, streaming & music charts
themes.businesses: independent movie theaters (opening weekend, wide-release count), cinema-adjacent restaurants, record stores/music venues
themes.story: Proxy: a weak tentpole opening or a thin release slate means empty seats and concessions.

themes.label: Concerts, tours, festivals, Broadway, halftime
themes.businesses: venues, hotels/bars/restaurants near festivals & theaters, merch printers
themes.story: Proxy: 'Broadway attendance', 'Coachella headliner', 'tour cancellations' track local event-driven traffic.

themes.label: Company KPIs, IPOs, M&A, CEOs
themes.businesses: suppliers/franchisees of the named company (e.g. a Chipotle or Starbucks franchise neighbour, Boeing supplier)
themes.story: Mostly speculation; some chain KPIs (Chipotle store count, Wendy's same-store sales) are sector proxies.

themes.label: Crypto prices
themes.businesses: merchants holding crypto receipts or treasury
themes.story: Hedge crypto treasury drawdowns; otherwise not a business risk.

themes.label: Elections, appointments & politics
themes.businesses: regulated businesses whose rules depend on who wins (cannabis, gaming, energy), government contractors
themes.story: Indirect: elections change regulation; specific policy markets above are tighter hedges.

themes.label: Geopolitics & conflict
themes.businesses: importers exposed to specific countries
themes.story: Mostly not a small-business hedge; oil-chokepoint markets are covered under crude_oil.

themes.label: Mentions, awards, celebrity & novelty
themes.story: Not a business risk.
